caption: The cord of a running vacuum cleaner snags on a doorframe and jerks out of the socket, and the vacuum stops.

sa.check: A vacuum cleaner runs, its cord running to a socket.
The cord snags on a doorframe.
The plug jerks out of the socket.
The cord is drawn taut against the doorframe before the plug comes out.
The order is running, snag, plug out, stopped.

pc.expect: The vacuum stops at the moment the plug leaves the socket, and only then: its brush roll or the fluff at its head stops moving and any light on it goes out.
pc.fail: The plug is out and the vacuum runs on to the end of the clip; or the vacuum stops before the cord has gone taut; or the vacuum stops with the plug still seated; or the vacuum's light stays lit with the plug out.

pc.expect: Once unplugged the vacuum stays stopped; it does not start again while the plug is out.
pc.fail: The vacuum starts again with the plug out; or runs in bursts; or the plug jumps back into the socket by itself; or the cord re-threads itself round the frame.

pc.expect: The cord is drawn taut against the frame before the plug comes out; once free it goes slack and drops.
pc.fail: The plug comes out while the cord hangs slack; or the cord stays stretched straight in the air after the plug is free; or the cord stretches like elastic; or the plug flies up and stays aloft.

pc.expect: The vacuum keeps moving only as far as it was being pushed; the cord's snag does not throw it about.
pc.fail: The vacuum is flung backward by the snag; or lifts off the floor; or reverses on its own; or spins round.

pc.expect: One vacuum, one cord, one plug, one socket; the cord stays continuous and passes through neither the frame nor the wall.
pc.fail: The cord passes through the doorframe; or splits or detaches; or the plug vanishes; or a second vacuum appears.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The vacuum's colour, the cord and the doorframe stay the same.
pc.fail: The vacuum changes colour; or the cord changes colour; or the doorframe changes.

note: The motor's sound is not judged; stopping is read from visible motion at the head, any indicator light and the dust or fluff settling. Who pushes the vacuum is not judged.
